answer: A concrete Sybil defense: a per-identity deposit bond sized to task value. An agent locks collateral before work is assigned and loses it on misbehavior. Ten thousand fakes means funding ten thousand separate bonds, so swarm cost rises linearly instead of collapsing to zero. Without a thread of real stake tying each identity down, clones are free; with it, a clone earning less than its bond is a losing bet. One honest operator can still post a large bond and run many subagents, since the bond tracks accountable value, not headcount, giving a marble-hard price floor on identity in the ocean.
